SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ......
S.1, Special Branch XXXXXX
REPORT    Date October 21, 1938.
Subject......News Article entitled "Allegations Against a Certain
Coal Company" appearing in the "Globe"
Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang    Forwarded by....................

With reference to the attached article entitled
"Allegations Against a Certain Coal Company" which appeared
in the "Globe", dated October 15, enquiries reveal that an
incident as described therein, actually took place in the
Nyi Tai Shing Coal Shop ( 義泰昌煤號 ), 182-184 Sinza
Road, on the occasion of the August 13th Anniversary.
During the morning of August 13, a shop assistant
named Yang Chih-ching ( 楊志清 ) hoisted a national flag
in observance of the anniversary but this action aroused
the dissatisfaction of the manager, Sung Ching-tseu ( 宋敬梓 ).
An altercation ensued with the result that the shop assistant
was dismissed on the following day.
Judging from the above fact, there is reason to
believe that this article was either inspired or contributed
by Yang Chih-ching in order to voice his grievance.
According to the manager, Yang Chih-ching is a native
of Zaushing, age about 20, who had been an assistant of the
shop for a period of five years. He received civic training
under the sponsorship of the Chinese authorities at Nantao
before the local hostilities, and participated in the first
aid services for the Chinese soldiers wounded at the Shanghai
front on the outbreak of the August 13th incident. After
the withdrawal of the Chinese forces from the Shanghai area,
Yang returned to the shop and continued his employment until
the occurrence of the recent dispute. He is said to have
left for the interior to join the mobile units of the new
Fourth Army now operating along the S.N.R. and S.H.H.R.

D.C. (Special Branch).    Sih Tse liang
                          C. D. I.

报告    日期 1938年10月21日。
主题......刊登于《环球报》（Globe）的题为“指控某煤号”的新闻文章
由刑事侦缉督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang）制作    转呈人....................

关于附件中题为“指控某煤号”并刊登于10月15日《环球报》的文章，经查询显示，文中所述事件确实发生于8月13日周年纪念期间，地点为辛扎路（Sinza Road）182-184号的义泰昌煤号。
8月13日上午，一名名为杨志清（Yang Chih-ching）的店员为纪念周年升起了国旗，但此举引起了经理宋敬梓（Sung Ching-tseu）的不满。随后发生争执，结果是该店员于次日被解雇。
鉴于上述事实，有理由相信这篇文章是由杨志清授意或撰写，以发泄其不满。
据经理称，杨志清是乍兴（Zaushing，音译）人，年龄约20岁，已在该店担任店员五年。在当地战事爆发前，他曾在南市接受中国当局赞助的市民训练，并在8月13日事变爆发时参与了上海前线受伤中国士兵的急救服务。在中国军队撤离上海地区后，杨返回店里继续工作，直至最近发生纠纷。据说他已前往内地，加入目前沿苏宁铁路（S.N.R.）和沪杭铁路（S.H.H.R.）作战的新四军流动部队。

D.C.（特别处）。    施子良
                  刑事侦缉督察

October 15, 1938. Morning Translation.

Globe publishes the following letter in its Reader's Forum:

ALLEGATIONS AGAINST A CERTAIN COAL COMPANY

To the Editor,
I was formerly an employee of a certain coal company and was dismissed from the post because I hoisted the national flag. The following are the particulars surrounding the case:-
I joined the firm in question during the 1932 hostilities. Upon seeing the fires and hearing the noise of gunfire in Chapei, our manager addressed the following words to a number of employees:- "The Japanese are barbarous. From now on, I will not deal with the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha and the Mitsubishi Shoji Kaisha." The coal departments of these two firms, however, enable coal merchants to make fortunes.
When an armistice was reached and the Japanese troops had withdrawn from Chapei, the manager forgot his words and dealt as usual with the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha and the Mitsubishi Shoji Kaisha. Despite the outbreak of the July 7 incident, the withdrawal of Chinese troops from Shanghai and the fall of Nanking, our manager was still closely related to these firms and furthermore, had secretly joined the Shanghai Citizens' Society. Following the assassination of Loh Pah-hung (陸伯鴻) and the receipt of a letter of warning, he no longer dared to work for the Society. For this reason, the running dogs of the two firms could not but appoint one Huang (黃), the favourite of our manager, to fill the vacancy.
On the anniversary of the August 13 incident, all shops in Shanghai hoisted the national flag. However, our manager who is still a Chinese prohibited us from doing so. From a motive of patriotism, I raised opposition to our manager. Although justice overcomes might and the national flag was eventually hoisted, yet I have been dismissed from my firm.

A Friend.

《环球报》在其读者论坛栏目刊登了以下信件：

指控某煤号

致编辑：
我曾是某煤号的雇员，因升起国旗而被解职。以下是该案的具体情况：
我在1932年战事期间加入了该商号。当看到闸北的火光和听到枪声时，我们经理对多名员工说了以下的话：“日本人野蛮残暴。从今以后，我将不与三井物产株式会社和三菱商事株式会社做生意。”然而，这两家公司的煤炭部门使煤炭商人得以发财致富。
当达成停战协定且日军从闸北撤出后，经理忘掉了自己的话，照常与三井物产株式会社和三菱商事株式会社进行交易。尽管七七事变爆发、中国军队撤离上海以及南京沦陷，我们经理仍与这些公司保持密切关系，此外，他还秘密加入了上海市民协会。在陆伯鸿（Loh Pah-hung）遇刺并收到警告信后，他不敢再为该协会工作。因此，这两家公司的走狗不得不任命经理的亲信黄某填补空缺。
在8月13事变周年纪念日，上海所有商店都升起了国旗。然而，身为中国人的我们经理却禁止我们这样做。出于爱国动机，我反对我们经理。虽然正义战胜强权，国旗最终得以升起，但我却被商号解雇。

一位朋友。
